reviews.comment:
Es un lugar muy concurrido, ir con tiempo. Es semiautomático, una primer etapa automático, con maquinaria que lava el exterior y queda estupendo, como nuevo. Luego, por dentro del vehículo es manual y no quedé conforme, la limpieza es regular, incompleta. No aspiran el baúl, no lo abren. Consulté y me indicaron que esa limpieza no la realizan.

(Translated by Google)
It's a very busy place, so go with plenty of time. It's semi-automatic; the first stage is automatic, with machinery that washes the exterior, leaving it looking fantastic, like new. Then, the interior cleaning is manual, and I wasn't satisfied. The cleaning was just okay, incomplete. They don't vacuum the trunk, and they don't open it. I inquired, and they told me they don't offer trunk cleaning.
